The drawn geometry has been measured and it does not soften the call: the rising channel's lower rail is at 1401.2, 28.4% below the 07-Aug close, so there is no near-term rising support and 'nothing to lean on until 1851.9' stands. Price (1957.70 at the study, 1973.7 on 10-Aug) sits INSIDE the daily MA knot 1917.6-2019.5, five sources, below the Bollinger basis (2019.5) and below the Supertrend (2147.7), with daily RSI under its MA (48.11 vs 49.51) and weekly RSI under its MA (62.89 vs 67.15). Structure intact on the weekly, momentum rolled over on two timeframes, and price in the middle of a band -- there is nothing to trade against from here. FIRST SUPPORT is 1851.90-1896.40, now FIVE sources including a hand-drawn ray measured at 1871.1. UPSIDE still needs a reclaim of 2098.59-2207.80, which contains the Supertrend and the Bollinger upper.
